As a result, gross profit grew at a stable rate, keeping in line with management’s expectations. The company’s operating income saw an uptick, indicating that the firm was able to manage its administrative and selling expenses effectively, while also benefiting from a more streamlined supply chain. This contributed to a higher operating margin, suggesting that the company’s core operations were becoming more efficient and profitable.
